marta: Acadia onboarding seeing bursts of 429s from our ephemeral token endpoint during CI prefetch. They run ~50 parallel runners.

devon: Likely a prefetch stampede. Do they use default SDK backoff?

marta: Yes. CI snippet: ```[WARN] 429 Too Many Requests /v1/ephemeral_tokens
[DEBUG] retry 100ms
[ERROR] retries exhausted```

alex: Quick plan: 1) request a short tenant burst from infra; 2) give them a single-flight + jitter snippet; 3) advise staggered starts or staged rollout.

ratebot: [alert] acadia-corp ephemeral_token rate 9x baseline. Auto-throttle engaged.

marta: I'll ask infra for a temporary exception and send the client patch now.

devon: Snippet to send: ```js
let inflight=null; async function getToken(){ if(inflight) return inflight; inflight=(async()=>{ for(let i=0;i<5;i++){ try{return await fetchToken();}catch(e){ await sleep(Math.floor(Math.random()*200)+(2**i)*100); }} throw new Error('failed'); })(); try{return await inflight;}finally{inflight=null;}}```

marta: Thanks — sending to Acadia and opening a playbook note for "prefetch stampede".
